summary: A four-story, ~230,000 sq ft affordable apartment building at 588 Mission Bay Blvd North (Mission Bay South Block 7 West) with 200 affordable apartments (SocketSite, 2015) and over 10,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail, developed by Related California in partnership with Chinatown Community Development Center and designed by David Baker Architects. SocketSite reported in January 2015 that groundbreaking was expected in April 2015, and the architect's own project page lists the building as completed in 2017.

open_questions: Precise completion month not found -- David Baker Architects' own project page gives only 'Completed 2017'.

DataSF's Assessor tax roll records no year_property_built for this parcel (blklot 8711226), consistent with status.csv's existing note; the 2017 completion year rests on the architect's project page rather than a public assessor or permit record.

A November 2016 UCSF news item describes the building as still welcoming applications ahead of opening, consistent with a 2017 (rather than the originally targeted September 2016) completion, but doesn't itself give a specific opening date.
Blue Bottle Coffee's confirmed opening date is not given by any source found (status: announced).

No date found for Blue Bottle Coffee's announced opening (588 Mission Bay Blvd North): the only source is a DBI sign permit, whose own text (a one-line sign description) carries no date; retail_confirmed.csv's own opened field is blank, as expected for an announced tenant with no confirmed opening yet.

2026-09-29: no source was found reporting that Five88's groundbreaking actually took place in April 2015 (SocketSite's January 2015 piece is a forecast); the unit count is 200 affordable apartments per SocketSite, while the DataSF Assessor roll lists 208 units on the 2023-2025 rolls (year built 2017), which is not reconciled.
